name: Kellogg's Museli Nuts delight
ingredients_raw: MULTIGRAIN MIX (67.6%) (CORN GRITS (21.2%), WHEAT (16.8%), ROLLED BARLEY (10.5%), ROLLED OATS (10.5%), RICE (8.6%), DRY FRUITS & NUT (20%) (BROWN RAISINS (10%), ALMONDS (6%), BLACK RAISINS (4%)), SUGAR, CEREAL EXTRACT, WHEAT BRAN, HONEY, OLIGOFRUCTOSE, IODIZED SALT, COCOA SOLIDS, VITAMINS. FLAVOURS (NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (COCONUT)), ANTIOXIDANT (INS 307b), MINERAL AND COLOUR (INS 150d). ALLERGEN DECLARATION: CONTAINS WHEAT, BARLEY, OATS, NUT (ALMONDS) AND SULPHITE. MAY CONTAIN OTHER NUTS, SOY AND MILK. SOME DRY FRUITS CONTAIN SULPHITE TO MAINTAIN COLOUR.
